first commit

Enhance database connection management and health monitoring: Introduced connection health check functionality, improved error handling and logging for database queries, and added event handlers for monitoring pool activity. Updated health check endpoint to provide detailed database status in server response.

V2.0 - Refactor database initialization and enhance quote handling: Introduced helper functions for loading images and waiting for database readiness. Updated createTables function to streamline database setup and added global discount support in quote calculations. Enhanced quote routes to include discount fields and adjusted total calculations accordingly, improving overall functionality and maintainability.

Enhance duplicate customer detection in customerUtils: Updated the findDuplicateCustomer function to include address and city matching alongside name and email. Improved the duplicate customer alert message to reflect identical data, enhancing clarity for user confirmation during customer entry.

Enhance duplicate customer handling in CustomerManagement: Updated the duplicate customer alert to allow user confirmation before proceeding. The process now only aborts if the user selects "Cancel," improving user experience and control during customer entry.

Refactor PDF generation for improved maintainability: Modularized PDF components, enhanced header and footer handling, and optimized page break logic. Introduced new functions for color configuration and tax calculations, while ensuring consistent styling across invoices and quotes. This refactor aims to streamline the PDF generation process and improve code organization.

Enhance PDF generation to conditionally display discounts: Added a helper function to check for discounts in invoice items and updated the PDF generation logic to dynamically adjust the display of discount-related columns based on the presence of discounts. This improves the clarity and usability of generated invoices and quotes.

Add address supplement feature: Implemented migration to add address_supplement column in customers table, updated customer routes to handle address supplement, and modified CustomerManagement and InvoiceEditor components to include address supplement input. Enhanced PDF generation to display address supplement where applicable.

Make discounts feature optional: Introduced discounts_enabled column in the database, updated company routes to handle discounts, and modified InvoiceEditor and QuoteEditor components to support discount functionality. Added settings option for enabling/disabling discounts.
Fix discounts not being accounted correctly while initial POST

Revise licensing information across multiple files: update LICENSE to clarify AGPL-3.0 terms, modify README to emphasize open-source nature and SaaS hosting permissions, and set license field in package.json files for both frontend and backend to AGPL-3.0.
